products.title: Carbon-Steel Skillet
products.description: The pan you’ll reach for every day. Spun from a single sheet of heavy carbon steel with a forged, riveted handle, it heats fast, sears hard, and takes a slick, natural non-stick seasoning that only improves with use. Oven-safe, flame-safe, and honestly the last frying pan you need.
products.seoTitle: Carbon-Steel Skillet — everyday frying pan | Copper & Cast
products.seoDescription: A heavy carbon-steel skillet with a forged handle that seasons to a natural non-stick and lasts a lifetime.

images.alt: A black carbon-steel skillet with a forged handle

products.title: Enamelled Cast-Iron Dutch Oven
products.description: A 5.5-quart cast-iron pot under a smooth enamel glaze — the workhorse for braises, bread, stews and Sunday sauce. Heavy walls hold a low, even heat for hours; goes stovetop to oven to table and comes clean with a wipe. One pot that does the work of five.
products.seoTitle: Enamelled Cast-Iron Dutch Oven, 5.5 qt | Copper & Cast
products.seoDescription: A 5.5-quart enamelled cast-iron Dutch oven for braises, bread and stews — stovetop to oven to table.

images.alt: An enamelled cast-iron Dutch oven with the lid off

products.title: Forged Chef’s Knife
products.description: The one knife that does ninety percent of the work. Forged from high-carbon steel and ground by hand to a keen, lasting edge, with a full tang and a bolster that puts the balance right at your grip. Rock-chop, slice, or dice all day — sharpen it now and then and it’ll outlast the block.
products.seoTitle: Forged Chef’s Knife — high-carbon steel | Copper & Cast
products.seoDescription: A hand-forged high-carbon chef’s knife with a full tang and balanced bolster that holds a keen edge.

images.alt: A forged carbon-steel chef’s knife on a board

products.title: Forged Paring Knife
products.description: The little knife you use more than you’d think — peeling, trimming, coring, deveining, and any close work the chef’s knife is too big for. Same forged high-carbon steel and full tang, sized to sit in your hand and steer with your fingertips. Buy it with the chef’s knife and skip the rest of the block.
products.seoTitle: Forged Paring Knife — high-carbon steel | Copper & Cast
products.seoDescription: A hand-forged high-carbon paring knife with a full tang for peeling, trimming and close work.

images.alt: A small forged paring knife beside cut herbs

products.title: Olive-Wood Spoon Set
products.description: A set of three utensils turned from a single piece of olive wood — a deep cooking spoon, a slotted spoon, and a flat-edged spatula for scraping a fond. Kind to seasoned pans and non-stick alike, warm in the hand, and beautiful enough to leave in the crock by the stove. Oil now and then; they last for years.
products.seoTitle: Olive-Wood Spoon Set — 3 piece | Copper & Cast
products.seoDescription: A three-piece olive-wood utensil set — cooking spoon, slotted spoon and spatula, kind to every pan.

images.alt: A set of olive-wood cooking spoons and a spatula

products.title: Tri-Ply Stainless Saucepan
products.description: A tri-ply saucepan with an aluminium core clad in stainless, so it heats evenly edge to edge with no hot spots — the pan for sauces, grains, blanching and reductions. A long stay-cool handle, a pouring lip, and a mirror interior that shows you exactly what your sauce is doing. Dishwasher-safe and induction-ready.
products.seoDescription: A tri-ply stainless saucepan with an aluminium core for even heat — sauces, grains and reductions.

images.alt: A tri-ply stainless saucepan with a long handle

products.title: Stainless Mixing-Bowl Set
products.description: A nesting set of five stainless bowls, from a tiny prep bowl to a big-batch mixing bowl — light, unbreakable, and the ones that get used every single day. Deep enough to whisk without a mess, flat-bottomed so they sit still, and they stack down to almost nothing in the cupboard.
products.seoTitle: Stainless Mixing-Bowl Set — 5 piece | Copper & Cast
products.seoDescription: A nesting five-piece stainless mixing-bowl set — light, unbreakable and used every day.

images.alt: A nesting set of stainless mixing bowls

products.title: Walnut Pepper Mill
products.description: A tall pepper mill turned from solid walnut over a hardened steel burr that grinds from a fine dust to a coarse crack and holds its setting. Freshly cracked pepper is a different ingredient than the pre-ground stuff — this is the small upgrade that makes everything you cook taste better.
products.seoTitle: Walnut Pepper Mill — steel-burr grinder | Copper & Cast
products.seoDescription: A tall solid-walnut pepper mill with a hardened steel burr, adjustable from fine dust to a coarse crack.

products.title: Starter Cookware Set
products.description: Everything a real kitchen needs and nothing it doesn’t: the carbon-steel skillet, the tri-ply saucepan, and the enamelled Dutch oven, bundled to build a kitchen from scratch. Three pans that cover searing, sauce and slow cooking — the set we’d hand someone moving into their first place. Priced below buying them apart.
products.seoTitle: Starter Cookware Set — skillet, saucepan & Dutch oven | Copper & Cast
products.seoDescription: A three-pan starter set — carbon-steel skillet, tri-ply saucepan and cast-iron Dutch oven — to build a kitchen from scratch.
